subject: vectorize XXH3_initCustomSecret  (#376)

units.name: vectorize XXH3_initCustomSecret  (#376)
units.evidence: Scalar and SSE2 raw custom-secret initialization checks include proofs, but SSE2 raw also gives a forward memory-mismatch witness at seed 2^63. Public XXH3 seeded targets time out or fail translation.

units.name: Public XXH3_64bits_withSeed: 256-byte SSE2 input, seed 2^63
units.evidence: Old public call returns under UBSan; new public call reaches signed-min negation UB in historical xxh3.h.

notes: A valid 256-byte public seeded-hash call returns in the parent and reaches signed-overflow UB in the child SSE2 path at seed 2^63.
